newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Q3 GDP fell 0.7 pct yr/yr and qtr/qtr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Q3 GDP fell 0.7 pct yr/yr and qtr/qtr.

text.p: Swiss gross domestic product (GDP) declined by an annualised 0.7 percent in the third quarter of 1996 from both the previous quarter and the year-earlier period, the Swiss Federal Office for Economic Policy said on Tuesday.
It said real consumption by private households dropped 1.0 percent from the previous quarter.
It said the overall price level or deflator was down 0.2 percent from a year earlier, the steepest decline since early 1977.
The GDP quarterly decline was the seventh in a row after contracting a revised 1.0 percent in the second quarter, up slightly from a provisional figure of 0.9 percent.
The office had confirmed the GDP third quarter figure on Monday, a day ahead of its official release, after the number became widely known in banking circles.
